decisions.reason: It deepens the firm's floor-care system, gained stronger web prominence in 2024, and should support aftersales revenue from the installed base.
It fits the maintenance promise for wooden floors, but its lower web prominence suggests more limited demand and some overlap with other care items.
A dedicated 2024 page signals commitment and traction, and specialised care for oiled floors reinforces the firm's premium technical-service positioning.
Moisture-protection underlay is a sensible installation accessory, though as a less differentiated add-on it is somewhat more exposed to range simplification.
High-density underlay foam looks the most replaceable commodity accessory in the 2023-2024 launches and is the likeliest candidate for pruning from a medium-width range.
Oak parquet is close to the firm's core flooring business and supports design breadth, so despite modest web emphasis it is still likely to remain.
